[SWS_DM_00563] Monitor initialization for operation cycle restart reason
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04186
⌈
If an
operation cycle
is restarted by calling the method
ara::diag::Opera-
tionCycle::RestartOperationCycle
, for all monitors that are mapped via
Di-
agnosticEventToOperationCycleMapping
to the restarted
operation cycle
,
the DM shall call the registered notifier method
initMonitor
with the parameter
ara::diag::InitMonitorReason
set to
kRestart
.
⌋
